title: TST: batch determinism cases by output format
body:
<!-- Thank you for your contribution! -->
<!-- 👉 Please check our development guide https://matplotlib.org/devdocs/devel/index.html -->

## PR summary

Groups the determinism test output formats together and returns multiple figures from a subprocess call and then loads those multiple files for comparisons. Goes from ~77s to ~38s locally for me, this test has historically been our slowest.
